meta.extractedFrom: HR Dashboard Ledger EN.dc.html (Bold Editorial / Ledger direction, approved 2026-09-30)
meta.note: Light theme only — no dark-mode values exist yet in any approved mockup. Do not invent dark values; add a real dark theme only once one is designed. Every value below was re-verified against the exact attached file by script, not eyeballed.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Primary brand color. Header/hero background, primary buttons, primary data numerals, active nav underline base.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Radial gradient dark end inside navy gradient meshes (hero, attendance card). Never a flat fill on its own.

tokens.name: navy-glow
tokens.usage: Radial highlight accent inside navy gradient meshes. Decorative only.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: the primary CTA pill ('+ Add employee'), active-tab underline, 'Urgent' tag fill, large identity moments (24px+). KNOWN ISSUE, not yet resolved: white-on-coral and coral-on-white both measure 3.10:1 — below WCAG AA (4.5:1) for text under 24px. The source file currently uses plain coral at 11-13px in two places ('Urgent' tag text, CTA button label) that technically fail this. Flagging, not silently fixing — decide when convenient whether to accept this as a deliberate brand tradeoff or introduce a darker small-text variant.

tokens.name: coral-hover
tokens.usage: Exact hover background for the coral CTA button, as built (style-hover="background:#D0603F" on '+ Add employee').

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Exact hover background for the white outline/secondary buttons ('Run payroll'), as built.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on light surfaces. 15.36:1 on page.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary/meta text — KPI captions, row sub-text, header date line. 5.03:1 on page, 5.48:1 on white.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The decision-queue row index numerals ('01' '02' '03') only.

tokens.name: avatar-fallback
tokens.usage: Background shown behind a person photo while it loads, for decision-queue and 'Coming up' avatars. Note: the header's own user avatar uses a different fallback (avatar-fallback-header, #8FA3B5) in the source file — inconsistency kept as found, not unified; worth a deliberate decision later.

tokens.name: avatar-fallback-header
tokens.usage: Background shown behind the header user-avatar photo while it loads. Distinct from avatar-fallback (#C9D2DA) used elsewhere — see that token's note.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background; also the gap color that reads as the 1px structural grid between ledger blocks.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card/section fill inside the ledger grid.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Structural rule around/between ledger blocks (outer border, the grid gap fill).

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Lighter row dividers inside a single card (between decision-queue rows, department rows).

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Primary text/icons on navy or coral fills.

tokens.name: on-navy-muted-70
tokens.usage: Secondary text on navy: 'vs. yesterday', the attendance card's '1284' label.

tokens.name: on-navy-muted-75
tokens.usage: Day-of-week labels under the attendance bars specifically — the source uses .75 here vs .7 elsewhere; kept distinct rather than merged.

tokens.name: on-navy-muted-85
tokens.usage: Inactive role-switch label ('Department Manager') text on the navy hero.

tokens.name: on-navy-faint-28
tokens.usage: Inactive attendance bar fill (decorative chart track). Never for text.

tokens.name: on-navy-border-18
tokens.usage: Header bottom hairline on the navy hero.

tokens.name: on-navy-border-35
tokens.usage: Attendance chart baseline rule.

tokens.name: on-navy-border-50
tokens.usage: Borders on the outline chips ('17 leave requests' etc.) in the hero.

tokens.name: on-navy-border-60
tokens.usage: Border on the 'Post a job' outline button.

tokens.name: on-navy-fill-12
tokens.usage: Subtle fills on navy: the search field, the role-switch pill track, and the 'Post a job' button's hover state (same value, two contexts).

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: 'Good morning, {name}'. Source is fluid clamp(40px,7vw,80px); 80px is the exact value at any viewport ≥1142px (typical desktop). Implementation should keep the fluid clamp, not hardcode 80px on narrow screens.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: 'Awaiting your decision'. Source clamp(24px,3vw,30px); 30px exact at viewports ≥1000px.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: 'Headcount by department', 'Coming up'. Source clamp(20px,2.6vw,26px); 26px exact at viewports ≥1000px.

styles.name: body-md
styles.usage: Decision-queue row titles ('Leave requests', 'Run payroll'...). Upcoming-list person names use the same size at -0.015em.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Nav items, buttons, hero chip labels, decision-action button labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: KPI captions, row sub-text, header date line, search placeholder, 'Present/Absent' legend.

styles.name: data-xl
styles.usage: The attendance ring's hero metric ('96.2'), paired with a 26px '%' suffix on the same line.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: KPI strip values. Source clamp(34px,3.6vw,44px); 44px exact at viewports ≥1222px. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: data-xs
styles.usage: Decision-queue row index ('01'/'02'/'03'), paired with ink-faint color.

styles.name: data-xs-delta
styles.usage: KPI delta value (the colored +/-N% figure only, not its gray suffix text which is sans/caption-sm).

styles.name: data-2xs
styles.usage: The '+14' / '1+' overflow count next to an avatar stack.

styles.name: data-3xs
styles.usage: Attendance day-of-week labels (Sat/Sun/...) and the 'Ctrl K' keyboard hint. Both plain weight, not bold.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Ledger grid gaps (the 1px-look gutter between blocks is this gap filled with the hairline/page color); day-column gaps in the attendance chart.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Small icon-to-label gaps (search-field internal gap, presence-dot margin).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Button row gaps, logo-to-wordmark gap.

tokens.name: space-2-5
tokens.usage: Header vertical padding; 'Run payroll'/'Post a job' button padding (paired with 20px horizontal).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Nav item padding, decision-row gaps, upcoming-row gaps.

tokens.name: space-3-5
tokens.usage: Search field horizontal padding; KPI tile padding; department row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Hero content gap, day-of-week chart gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card horizontal padding throughout the ledger (KPI tiles, decision rows, department rows, 'Coming up' rows), CTA button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding bottom, avatar-to-greeting gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page horizontal margin (header and hero gutters).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero top padding; footer spacer height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Default corner: logo tile, buttons, card/photo corners — the Ledger direction's sharp structural default.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, tags ('Urgent', hero chips, role-switch segments), the coral primary CTA, the search field, KPI/decision count badges.

tokens.name: radius-circle
tokens.usage: Avatar photos, presence dots.

shadow.note: This system uses no drop shadows anywhere. Separation between sections comes from the 1px hairline structural grid and solid color blocking, not elevation.
